title: Bind every telemetry test to the item and the acceptance that requires it

facts.note: Rule applies only to test files. The Bun realization (validator bun_telemetry_test, `//` header comments) is implementation context, not an activation gate.

Needs a content observer that detects every real `Telemetry:` header line (not inside a string literal) in a test file, whether the test was edited or not; the bun_telemetry_test validator provides it.
Rule is inert until the repository adopts the telemetry rule family; needs an adoption-state observer.

fires: A test file contains a `Telemetry:` header whose URN is malformed or does not resolve to a tracking-plan item.
A test file has a `Telemetry:` header but no `Acceptance:` header.
A test's `Acceptance:` binding names an acceptance not declared in the plan.
A test binds a telemetry item and one or more acceptances, but none of the bound acceptances' telemetry decisions lists that item.

An unchanged test's existing `Telemetry:` header becomes invalid after the tracking plan changes (item removed, acceptance removed, or decision no longer lists the item) and is found during validation.
doesNotFire: A test is a telemetry test only by URN kind segment (TELEMETRY/EVENT/METRIC) or *.telemetry.test.* colocation, with no `Telemetry:` header (captured-sink and identity rules judge it).
The text `Telemetry:` appears only inside a string literal.
A spec file binds many acceptances and at least one of them requires the bound item.
The repository has not adopted the telemetry rule family.

given: A test file contains a real `Telemetry:` header (a telemetry test) in a repository that has adopted the telemetry rule family
when: the test is validated or its headers are written or changed, including unchanged tests re-judged after tracking-plan changes
then: Each `Telemetry:` header must be a well-formed concrete URN resolving to a tracking-plan item, and the test must carry `Acceptance:` bindings to declared acceptances, at least one of whose telemetry decisions requires that item.
prefer: Bind both ends of the proof: `// URN: test:commons:ingress:E001-UNIT-001` / `// Acceptance: acc:commons:E001-UNIT-001` / `// Telemetry: telemetry:event:be:commons:response-invocation-accepted`.
In a spec covering many acceptances, ensure at least one bound acceptance's decision lists the item.
avoid: Binding an item with no acceptance — it proves something nobody required.
Binding an acceptance whose decision does not list the item — a test proves a requirement, not an acquaintance.
Non-concrete or unresolvable Telemetry URNs; Acceptance bindings absent from the plan.
unless: Telemetry test only by URN segment or colocation (no `Telemetry:` header): judged by the captured-sink and identity rules instead.
Repository has not adopted this rule family (inert until adoption, like every rule in it).
why: This is the @covers edge of the telemetry graph (acceptance → item → test); without both bindings a test proves nothing required or a relationship the plan never declared.
evidence: bun_telemetry_test validator reports no finding for any `Telemetry:` header line in the test file.
For each header: URN parses, resolves in the tracking-plan registry, Acceptance: bindings are present and exist in the plan, and ≥1 bound acceptance's telemetry decision lists the item.
verifier_detail: telemetry_test = a test file with a Telemetry: header, a TELEMETRY/EVENT/METRIC URN kind segment, or *.telemetry.test.* colocation; this rule only judges files with a Telemetry: header.
bound_acceptance = the acceptance named by the test's Acceptance: header; its telemetry decision must list the bound item — a test proves a requirement, not an acquaintance.

Every Telemetry: header in a test file is judged on its own line, in order: concrete-URN grammar, registry resolution, presence of Acceptance: bindings, the bindings' existence in the plan, and at least ONE bound acceptance's decision actually requiring the bound item.
A spec file legitimately covers many acceptances (the two-level @covers model); the requiring one may be any of them, so the judgement is over the whole set — none requiring is the finding.
A header inside a string literal is not a header — ignore it.
audit: Source name: 'Telemetry tests bind the acceptance and the item they prove'

sharedNodes.text: Disposition strict: atdd-bun fails on every finding; there is no advisory mode and no ratchet baseline.

additions.text: Activation facts, fires/doesNotFire lists and the `when` phrasing (every real Telemetry: header is judged on validation, including unchanged tests after tracking-plan changes, as well as on header edits).
additions.justification: Required by the target structure; derived from the source's terms, normative text ('Every Telemetry: header in a test file is judged') and exceptions, without narrowing scope.
